title_zh: 核对社区阅读项目资助的用途和承诺

scenario.label_zh: 核对社区阅读项目资助的用途和承诺
scenario.goal_zh: 确认资助金额只能用于约定的阅读活动，并安排收据保存和结项报告

context_zh: 社区阅读项目协调员与同事核对虚构的资助通知和项目计划。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: The Green Street Foundation has approved our application. We have funding for six reading sessions.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Great. Can we use some of it to repaint the hall?

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: No. The letter says this fund is for books, tutor time and transport to the sessions.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Then the painting needs a separate budget. What do we have to report?

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Attendance and spending. We also need to explain whether we were able to fulfill our promise of six sessions.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: We have dates for all six. I will keep the attendance records and receipts together.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: I will draft the final report after the last session, not before we know what happened.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Agreed. Let us put those responsibilities in the project folder now.
